description: DNA-equivalent (L1, L2, L3) triple manifest for a kotoba-datomic-mountable record kind. A record is kotoba-datomic-valid only if all three membrane layers (Lexicon schema + Rego policy + LangGraph deterministic cell) accept it. Per kotoba-datomic SPEC §4 + ADR-2605231400.

nsid.description: The record kind this membrane rule applies to (e.g., 'com.etzhayyim.maps.building').

schemaRef.description: L1 — Lexicon schema reference. Path to a Lexicon JSON file under 00-contracts/lexicons/ with content hash.

policyRef.description: L2 — Rego policy reference. Path to a Rego module under 00-contracts/policies/ with content hash. Evaluates Charter Rider §2, doctrinal positions, and capability scope.

cellRef.description: L3 — LangGraph cell reference. Path to a Pregel cell directory under 40-engine/kotoba/crates/kotoba-kotodama/cells/ with content hash of the deterministic step function source. Must be replica-deterministic per kotoba-datomic SPEC §7.

quorumSize.description: Number of witness cells to select for each write (Holochain-iso default: 5). Larger = stronger guarantee, more fleet load.

quorumThreshold.description: Minimum number of matching 'accept' attestations required to mark the record kotoba-datomic-witnessed (default: 3). Must be ≤ quorumSize and > quorumSize/2 for Byzantine-fault tolerance.

escalationPolicy.description: What to do when quorum is not reached. 'reject' = drop write, surface error to caller. 'council' = escalate to Council Lv6+ ≥3 multisig (ADR-2605192300). 'pending' = retain record as unwitnessed, retry witness selection on a clock.

ciphertextOnly.description: When true, the membrane evaluates the record's envelope (signature, format) only and never decrypts the payload — used for com.etzhayyim.encrypted.* records per ADR-2605181100. The Rego policy and LangGraph cell receive a ciphertext-bytes input rather than the deserialized record.

supersedesNsid.description: If this membrane rule replaces an earlier rule for the same record kind (e.g., schema migration), name the prior rule's NSID. Old attestations remain valid against the prior rule; new writes are evaluated against this rule.

layerRef.description: Reference to a single membrane layer artifact (schema, policy, or cell) by repo-relative path + content hash. Content hash is sha256 of the canonicalized file contents — enables re-attestation reproducibility and membrane version pinning.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the layer artifact.

contentHash.description: sha256 hex digest of the canonicalized layer source. For Lexicon JSON: sorted-keys + LF newlines. For Rego: source as-is. For cell directory: sha256 over the sorted tar of the cell's tracked files.

version.description: Human-readable version label. Semver for schema / policy; git-sha-7 for cell.
